violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: kitchen equipment and utensils cleaned in chlorine sanitizer solution dish machine with 0ppm concentration at the time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS instructed CFM to utilize the 3 vat sink to clean and sanitize kitchen equipment using chlorine or alternative food-grade sanitizer solution until chlorine dish machine has a concentration between 100-200ppm per the manufacturers instructions. EHS instructed CFM to obtain chlorine/ bleach ASAP (only germicide Clorox available at the time of inspection).

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials (three cans of febreeze) are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of single service items (red and white checkered parchment serving paper) on shelf on the front prepline.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: CFM relocated the three cans of febreeze to a chemical shelf in the back main kitchen area.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: rice scoops/ spoons stored in container of standing water (67F) next to rice warmer on the prep line in the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: CFM discarded the standing water, washed, rinsed, and sanitized the rice scoops and spoons. CFM will keep rice scoops and spoons dry in between use on clean food contact surface near the rice warmer.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Box of plastic to-go box lids were found stored on floor in front of the front hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. CDI: CFM relocated the box of plastic to-go box lids to dry storage shelf in the main kitchen. MASHAHWEEZ (Inspection Date: 10/09/2026) Page 2 of 3
